description: The facts Borgo encodes by hand (tax models, abortion and same-sex couples law, paid leave, election results, residence rules, corrected figures), each with the day it is due to be compared with its official source again, the most overdue first. Each row says why it is due, links its current source and gives the target to use with propose_change.

asOf.description: The day to compare against, YYYY-MM-DD (default today)

country.description: ISO alpha-2: only this country's facts

within.description: Also list facts due within this many days (default 0: only those already due)

name: list_stale
title: Facts due for review
